findings.text: A vdpa driver bearing the name virtio_vdpa offers probe handling that establishes a virtio view above a vdpa transport plus remove handling that withdraws that view. Probe performs identification with registration and private association while remove reverses registration using previously stored association.

The bridge object moves from unallocated to allocated but unregistered to registered and bound and finally to unregistered and freed. Invalid identification prevents registration with direct freeing while accepted registration transfers lifetime to device core with later freeing through a dedicated destructor.

Queue affinity lookup delegates to the underlying transport operation when that operation exists and otherwise signals absence with a null result. Callers must treat null as legitimate absence of information rather than as failure.

The configuration contract for the bridge spans status management plus feature negotiation plus reset plus queue discovery and teardown plus device configuration access plus generation tracking plus bus naming plus queue affinity control. Upper layers interact only through this table of handlers.

Successful creation requires nonzero device identification plus vendor identification plus accepted registration. Parent choice depends on presence of a mapping object. Private association follows registration. Cleanup follows the registration outcome with core release when registered and immediate freeing otherwise.

The descriptor called amba_device combines a member called dev for generic handling plus a member called res for address extent plus a member called pclk for clock plus a member called dma_parms for DMA limits plus a member called periphid for identity plus a member called periphid_lock for guarding plus a member called cid plus a member called uci plus a member called irq for interrupts sized by a central count.

The descriptor called amba_driver combines a member called drv for generic binding plus callbacks called probe plus remove plus shutdown for lifecycle plus a table called id_table for matching plus a flag called driver_managed_dma for self managed address space.

The AMBA device descriptor includes a mutex member called periphid_lock alongside the identifier member called periphid. The fragments show presence of the guard but do not show acquisition order or critical sections.
The record called amba_cs_uci_id combines a value called devarch plus a mask called devarch_mask plus a value called devtype plus opaque context called data.
The bus contract fixes interrupt slots per device at nine with generic cell code 0xb105f00d and coresight cell code 0xb105900d. These values support validation of discovered hardware.
Discovery registers reside at fixed offsets with device type at 0xFCC and device architecture at 0xFBC.
Vendor encoding assigns ARM to 0x41 with ST to 0x80 plus Qualcomm to 0x51 plus LSI to 0xb6. The code occupies the manufacturer portion of peripheral identity.

Peripheral identity splits into configuration from shift 24 masked to eight bits plus revision from shift 20 masked to four bits plus manufacturer from shift 12 masked to eight bits plus part from shift zero masked to twelve bits. Helpers expose configuration and manufacturer and part views of a device.

Static instantiation helpers define bus devices with coherent mask cleared for one bus kind and all ones for the other plus a fixed size memory extent plus supplied interrupts plus identity plus platform context. Registration helpers connect a driver object to module or builtin lifecycle using standard hooks.

In the routed excerpt driver registration always reports failure and device type testing always reports false. Conversion from generic device to AMBA device derives the enclosing address from the embedded generic member.

Classic register layout places data at 0x00 with status and clear sharing 0x04 plus high line at 0x08 plus middle at 0x0C plus low at 0x10 plus early control at 0x14 plus flags at 0x18 plus identification and clear sharing 0x1C plus low power at 0x20 plus integer divisor at 0x24 plus fractional at 0x28 plus line control at 0x2C plus control at 0x30 plus fifo select at 0x34 plus mask at 0x38 plus raw at 0x3C plus masked at 0x40 plus clear at 0x44 plus DMA control at 0x48.

Extended layout overlays watermark control at 0x08 with timeout at 0x0C plus receive line at 0x1C plus transmit line at 0x2C and adds flow control at 0x50 plus thresholds at 0x54 and 0x58 and 0x5C and 0x60 plus integration hooks at 0x80 and 0x84 plus autobaud at 0x100 and 0x15C.

Alternate vendor layout relocates data to 0x04 with flags to 0x14 while divisors stay at 0x24 and 0x28 and line handling moves to 0x30 plus control to 0x34 plus fifo select to 0x38 plus mask to 0x40 plus raw to 0x44 plus masked to 0x48 plus clear to 0x4C plus DMA to 0x50.

Data words carry error reports at bits eleven down to eight for overrun plus break plus parity plus framing while a separate status word mirrors the same four events at bits three down to zero. Flag reporting covers modem inputs with fifo state and busy between, and the alternate vendor shifts busy to eight plus data set ready to three plus clear to send to one plus ring to zero. Combined masks join the four status bits plus the three modem bits plus transmit full with busy.

Control enables hardware flow at bits fifteen and fourteen plus outputs and modem drives near the top plus receive and transmit near bits nine and eight plus loopback at seven plus early interrupt enables at six down to three with oversampling sharing bit three on one variant plus infrared modes at two and one plus master enable at zero. Line control selects stick parity at seven plus length codes 0x60 and 0x40 and 0x20 and 0x00 for eight down to five plus fifo enable at four plus stop plus parity select plus parity enable plus break at three down to zero.

Watermark control splits into receive levels in bits five to three plus transmit levels in bits two to zero with seven encodings spanning one up to forty eight entries. Fifo interrupt selection uses the same split with encodings for one eighth up to seven eighths plus an additional half full code. Early identification reports timeout plus transmit plus receive plus modem events at bits three down to zero.

Interrupt handling shares bit positions ten down to zero across mask plus raw status plus clear views for overrun plus break plus parity plus framing plus timeout plus transmit plus receive plus data set ready plus data carrier plus clear to send plus ring. DMA control adds error handling at bit two plus transmit enable at one plus receive enable at zero.

One platform record carries a hook called set_mctrl for modem lines. The other combines a filter called dma_filter plus params called dma_rx_param and dma_tx_param plus polling controls called dma_rx_poll_enable plus dma_rx_poll_rate plus dma_rx_poll_timeout plus lifecycle hooks called init and exit.

The console switch table combines ownership plus startup plus per console setup and teardown plus switching plus blanking plus geometry resizing plus font install and query and default plus palette install plus text clearing plus single and batched glyph output plus cursor handling plus viewport scrolling plus history adjustment plus origin selection plus screen saving plus attribute construction plus region inversion.

Console property flags occupy bits zero through nine for buffer printing plus console device plus enabled plus boot plus anytime plus braille plus extended plus suspended plus nonblocking operation plus atomic unsafe takeover.
Scrolling distinguishes an upward direction from a downward direction. Nonblocking priority increases numerically from none through normal and emergency and panic to a maximum sentinel.

Nonblocking state shares storage between an atomic word called atom and a split view with priority called prio spanning two bits plus requested priority called req_prio spanning two bits plus flags called unsafe and unsafe_takeover of one bit each plus a CPU identifier called cpu spanning twenty four bits.

Acquisition context groups caller supplied console plus spin limit plus priority plus takeover permission with an emit supplied backlog flag plus acquire supplied buffers plus sequence number. Write context wraps that acquisition state plus an output span via outbuf plus len plus a flag called unsafe_takeover, with optional execution identity when configured.
Display registration plus debug entry and exit are empty operations in the routed excerpt, accepting their arguments with no observable effect. Callers may invoke them unconditionally.

Several offsets serve multiple functions distinguished only by access direction or by device variant, so address alone does not identify function. Accessors must select the correct semantic view for direction and revision or they will confuse status with control.

Affinity callers must handle null as valid absence. Probe cleanup must follow the registration outcome, since only the registered path transfers lifetime to core release while the unregistered path frees directly. Mixing the paths risks double release or leak.
External container address helper relied on for deriving enclosing structures.
External zeroed allocation helper relied on for object creation.
External private retrieval helper relied on during removal.
External mapping helper relied on for parent selection.
External private association helper relied on after registration.
